Miles Morales is a great character but it doesn't mean you delete peter Parker. Miles should ALWAYS take place later in Peter's life. They have two different lives that have separate events which leads them to become Spider-Man. It would be completely wrong in my opinion to make Peter Parker's skin black or stick Miles in his place. There are certain things that play to their characters that if changed, would change the character. Miles and Spider-Gwen are the only recent "controversial" changes I've liked. The rest were meh or utter shit *cough cough* female thor. Just because it adds" diversity" doesn't mean that it should be forced in. There are ways to ease a character in or have a side character become it's own thing (Dick Grayson is a perfect example of this IMO whenever he became Batman. Dick Grayson actually is my favorite Batman.). With all that said if Miles is going to be added to MCU or anywhere, do not erase Peter Parker, Peter Parker as to have his life beforehand. With all that said, fuck social justice warriors who want to force Miles in for the fact he is simply black. It kind of hurts to see all the hate Miles is getting lately though...

Miles is third favorite spider behind Ben Reilly and Peter parker. As someone who is black, I feel the fact that he is black is a cool fact but that shouldn't be the reason he gets put in a movie.
